claim_boundary.authorized_if_confirmation_passes: On previously unseen physical material samples, decision-directed selection among logged robot presses reduces held-contact decision regret more efficiently than task-agnostic system identification while abstaining when no indentation is certified.
not_authorized: safety certification outside the released RCT force range
claim_boundary.physical_unit: one RCT industrial reference material sample

calibration.role: calibrate one universal material-level upper-force residual without selecting the method

confirmation.role: one-shot confirmation after every source gate and artifact seal passes

fit.rule: all released material IDs outside calibration, source_test, and confirmation

source_test.role: single source-side promotion decision with no method changes afterward

dataset.name: RCT: A Robot-Collected Touch-Vision-Language Dataset for Tactile Generalization

force_limit.definition: empirical 0.60 quantile across fit materials of held p3/s3 normal-force increments at 1.2 mm

decision.policy: choose the deepest action whose simultaneous conformal upper force bound is at or below the fit-only force limit; abstain if no nonzero action is certified

regret.oracle: deepest action whose realized held force is at or below the force limit

budgets.cost_unit: one 1.2 mm logged robot press after the mandatory anchor
budgets.primary_summary: trapezoidal area under material-level regret versus additional-probe count

controls: exact average over all selectable-probe permutations
evaluation.primary_contrast: decision-directed regret AUC minus task-agnostic system-identification regret AUC
secondary_metrics: regret at each matched probe count

statistical_inference.primary_test: one-sided exact paired sign-flip test over 20 confirmation materials

fit.covariance: material-level empirical covariance of the 15 registered force coordinates
fit.response_coordinates: five registered press trajectories times indentation levels 0.4, 0.8, and 1.2 mm

force_observation.alignment: within each trajectory, indentation is maximum z_frame minus z_frame and is matched to the nearest registered indentation with maximum absolute mismatch 0.051 mm
force_observation.normal_force: absolute raw_fz minus the trajectory's shallowest-frame raw_fz

method.posterior: exact conditional Gaussian with registered shrinkage and jitter; observed probe coordinates are conditioned without target outcomes

decision_directed.objective: maximum expected reduction in posterior Bayes decision regret per probe

system_identification.objective: maximum Gaussian mutual information about every still-unobserved registered force coordinate, independent of the downstream utility

universal_conformal_guard.score: maximum standardized upper-force residual over every registered selector, budget, and nonzero action

promotion.target_failure_policy: freeze and report without retry, replacement, calibration, or method change
